hero.subtitle: The Next Generation of Church Management System.

intro.lead: Church management software for parish administrators and church leadership—unify families, sacramental registers, stewardship, ministries, and Mass intentions in one secure platform.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: EkklesiaNexus unifies parish people, stewardship, and ministry workflows for church administrators evaluating a modern church management system.

members.title: Families & Members
members.body: Maintain households, members, and roles in one connected member directory.

giving.title: Stewardship & Finance
giving.body: Record gifts, pledges, and stewardship in a family-first giving workflow.

events.title: Reports & dashboards
events.body: Review parish reports and dashboards built from records your team already maintains—role-gated, without AI or predictive analytics claims.

comms.title: Sacramental Registers
comms.body: Preserve your parish’s sacramental history accurately and make important records available when they are needed.

groups.title: Ministries & Groups
groups.body: Organize life groups, ministries, and small-group participation in one place.

volunteers.title: Church-Native Workflows
volunteers.body: Engineered around authentic parish structures, Catholic sacramental canons, BCC wards, and Mass intentions.

slider.title: A Connected Parish. A Clearer Mission.
slider.subtitle: Uniting every dimension of parish life through one intelligent platform.

dashboard.title: Dynamic Dashboard
dashboard.body: Your entire parish, thoughtfully connected in one intelligent view.

mobile.title: Community Dashboard View
mobile.body: Monitor your Basic Christian Community's growth, demographics, and membership status.

familyFinancial.title: Detailed Financial Insights
familyFinancial.body: Monitor parish stewardship health, outstanding contributions, and financial trends with precision.
familyFinancial.imageAlt: Parish financial stewardship overview with collection health and weekly collection trend

calendar.title: Family Profile & Details
calendar.body:
A unified view of every parish family, relationships, and sacramental connections.
Strengthen parish connections.

insights.title: Mass & Intentions
insights.body: Where every celebration is sacred, and every intention is cherished. Honor every Mass intention with reverence, precision, and pastoral care.

tech.title: Performance & Security
tech.subtitle: Engineered for Excellence: Lightning-fast performance, enterprise-grade security, and uncompromising data protection you can trust.

next.title: Scalable Cloud SaaS
next.body: Zero local server infrastructure needed. Automatic continuous updates and high availability multi-region cloud access.

perf.title: Modern & Intuitive
perf.body: Clean desktop and mobile responsive interface designed for rapid adoption by priests, staff, and volunteers.

ui.title: Enterprise Security
ui.body: Strict role-based access control, encrypted data storage, multi-tenant isolation, and complete audit logging.

testimonials.rowSubtitle: Built for pastors, parish secretaries, treasurers, and stewardship teams.
testimonials.cardsSubtitle: Sample voices illustrating how organized parish data supports calmer church administration.

namoBarnes.quote: This work now feels calm. Our members are organized and our pastors are supported.

marcusHale.quote: The tools we use each Sunday finally live in one place for the whole team.

jaraphWilson.quote: Families are easier to find, and giving follow-up no longer lives in a spreadsheet.

elenaBrooks.quote: Volunteer teams know where to show up. That alone changed our week.

priyaMenon.quote: Receipts and outstanding dues are clear now. I can answer a family in the same visit.

thomasOkonkwo.quote: Baptism and marriage registers are easier to find, and certificates take minutes, not an afternoon.

claireDsouza.quote: I can see the household, not just a name. Pastoral visits are planned with far less searching.

jasonRamos.quote: EkklesiaNexus keeps our parish records, giving, and follow-up in a workflow our volunteers can actually use.

jessenDillon.quote: We moved from scattered notes to one family view. Sunday follow-up is finally simple.

desteniRobins.quote: Leaders can see who is serving, who gave, and who needs a pastoral visit — without extra tools.
